attributes.name: Flow Granada
attributes.description:
Just a 10-minute walk from Granada Metro Station, Flow Granada is where life, learning, and leisure come together. Flow Granada offers luxury 2- to 3-bedroom apartments in one of Riyadh’s most well-connected neighborhoods. Designed for families, professionals, and expats, this community blends high-end living with unmatched convenience — including an on-site school and full-service restaurant.

Apartments are fully furnished with modern interiors, smart home features, and generous layouts. Beyond your front door, Flow Granada provides access to green spaces, co-working areas, fitness facilities, and weekly community events.

Whether you're relocating to Riyadh or upgrading your lifestyle, Flow Granada is a destination for those who want to live fully — without compromise.
